Select molecule ChEMBL identifier, molecule name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL3227967. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by doc_chembl_id CHEMBL3227967. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to include canonical SMILES. Sort by molecule ChEMBL identifier. Do not deduplicate.
